limits.identities: Exact observed heuristic value_name strings, not signed primitive fact IDs. Aliases may merge or split facts.
limits.candidates: Only first CAP=2000 row/literal pairs per A condition are named.
limits.coverage: Within each scheme, sets retain up to KEEP=200 names per A condition. Thresholds use fixed frequency order on retained incidence, not an optimized minimum set cover.
limits.global_coverage: Not computed; marginal name frequencies do not encode condition/name incidence.
limits.growth_axis: Processed post-SAT unknown-condition subsequence, not full original sample or all minimal candidates.
limits.rss_budget: Plan rss_gib=14 is not enforced in the table workflow branch; that branch invokes time directly without profile_memory monitor.
limits.resources: Known sum over 11 available command time reports, including timeout; missing failed case is unknown, not zero. Sum of job wall is not workflow elapsed.
limits.source_scope: Other 10 ZIP primary records and full source ref were not reread in this pass; their receipt provenance was cross-checked against saved manifest and summary. No network fetches or reruns.
limits.full_registry: 12 pilot schemes only; no full-library or whole-scheme value extrapolation.

analysis_execution.scope: local value-counter parse/union; not pilot resources; wall excludes startup,CPU is process total
